messages:
emma: heads up — tenant Brightline on dedicated eu-west-1 is seeing repeated 429s and tail latency spikes over the last 12m. support ticket #12345. metrics show KV cache evictions ramping up when long sessions hit ~20-30k tokens.

emma: attaching quick traces and the eviction histogram: https://redwood.internal/logs/trace/abc123 (internal)

infra-bot: alert: ded-pool-3 kv_eviction_rate > 75th pct for 5m; autoscaler action suppressed due to scale_down_blocked flag at 2419801250

raj: oncall — looking. can you confirm model + quant config and whether prefix caching was enabled for those requests? also is the tenant pinned to ded-pool-3 or using shared capacity?

luis: quick summary from infra: tenant is pinned to ded-pool-3, model=redwood-xl-16k-q4 (quantized), batch pattern is lots of single-user longctx streams. prefix caching was ON. slab allocator shows fragmentation (many small free chunks, slow compaction). free_kv_memory shows sawtooth with rapid drops post-evict.

olivia: repro steps we used in staging (short):
```bash
# simulate long context stream
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/generate \n    -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n    -d '{"model":"redwood-xl-16k-q4","input":"'$(printf 'tok%.0s' {1..25000})'"}' &
done
```
This produced the same eviction spike and 429s within ~7 minutes.

raj: thanks. immediate mitigations we can try: 1) flip prefix caching off for Brightline (reduces KV churn) 2) temporarily cap max_context to 8k on their routing rule 3) allow burst reserve to spill to shared pool if policy permits. any of these are quick to apply and should reduce eviction pressure.

luis: long-term fixes: schedule aggressive slab compaction (set slab_compaction_threshold=0.7 for ded-pool-3), add a fast-path GC to coalesce small free segments, and modify autoscaler to consider kv_free_ratio < 0.15 as a scale-up signal (today it only looks at cpu/gpu). opening infra PR and a config change.

emma: customer is ok with a short-term cap. i'll apply cap and monitor. can you queue the compaction job and the autoscaler tweak? tag me when PR is ready.

olivia: adding notes to ticket #12345, setting priority P1 and assigning to @luis + @raj. Also noting billing impact potential (tenant saw ~3x request retries -> higher token usage).

support-bot: ticket #12345 updated: priority=P1, assignees=[luis, raj], labels=[dedicated, kv-evict, long-context]

raj: follow-ups: collect heap snapshots and slab histograms at T+5m and T+30m, and if we still see >60% eviction rate after mitigations, we escalate to capacity purchase for Brightline (reserve extra slab).

emma: done — i'll post snapshots and the customer ack when available. thanks all. :thumbsup:
